page.content:
Coalition led in the end by Britain, the United States, and the Soviet Union.

How Allies connects

  • Faction: Axis — The Allies fought the Axis to unconditional surrender.
  • Topic: World War II — The Allies are the coalition that defeated the Axis.
  • Character: Winston Churchill — Churchill was Britain's wartime leader in the Grand Alliance.
  • Character: Franklin D. Roosevelt — Roosevelt led the United States into and through the Alliance.
  • Event: D-Day — D-Day was a British, American, and Canadian coalition landing.
  • Character: Joseph Stalin — Stalin's Soviet Union was the eastern pillar of the Alliance.
  • Character: Dwight D. Eisenhower — Eisenhower was supreme Allied commander in the west.
  • Faction: United Nations — The UN was built to keep the wartime Allies in a permanent body.

What is Allies?

The Allies grew from the countries that resisted German, Italian, and Japanese expansion into the Grand Alliance. Their wartime conferences shaped occupation and the UN.

Key threads lead to Axis, World War II, Winston Churchill, Franklin D. Roosevelt, D-Day and Joseph Stalin.
